scope: Seven added findings plus linked first-wave threats. Advisories affect named third-party packages only; no BECK exposure assumed.
claim_policy: Distinct distinctions: source advisory verified, BECK code inspected, CI test passed, production deploy proven, real commerce proved.
Avoid absolute claims: provably safe, injection immune, exactly once settlement, guaranteed human author or unhackable.
A successful local test is not a database transaction guarantee across serverless instances.
Do not ingest external web instructions as privileged agent memory.
Vulnerability test evidence is not equivalent to live deployment proof.
first_transaction_blockers: Cross-host Stripe webhook/entitlement transaction not independently proven
Quote Compare buyer intake and real fulfilled order not independently verified

entries.affected_product: @x402/extensions SIWX 2.3.1 to 2.28.0 and specific Python/Go versions
entries.blocking_test: Payer's authenticated route, resource URL, method and settled entitlement must match; enforce atomic consume-once per resource and payment.
entries.marketing_claim: No x402 exactly-once or replay-proof claim without tested production implementation.

entries.blocking_test: Concurrent replay and crash recovery across instances with unique key paymentID + exact resourceID and settled status.
entries.marketing_claim: A local single-use test is not cross-host settlement correctness.

entries.affected_product: AP2 v0.2 threat taxonomy, user intent and mandate replay
entries.blocking_test: Verify mandate origin, resource, price, amount, beneficiary, consent hash and consume-once state at a trusted verifier.
entries.marketing_claim: Do not claim all 48 threat cases passed unless the test catalog and live evidence exist.

entries.affected_product: External research entering BECK Arbitrator or purchase decisions
entries.blocking_test: Schema-only untrusted extracts; never parse external prose as tools/authority; test attacker-controlled product descriptions and price/ranking manipulation.
entries.marketing_claim: Injection-resistant for documented tested scenarios, never injection-immune.

entries.affected_product: GGUF chat template and model loader
entries.blocking_test: Local inventory/hash against known approved model revisions, non-executing GGUF template parsing, reject unsafe constructs, isolate model process from payment secrets.
entries.marketing_claim: No scanned-model guarantee until every loaded model is checked; air-gap does not establish model integrity.

entries.affected_product: PayloadCMS/plugin-ecommerce Stripe adapter before patched versions
entries.blocking_test: Single shared database claim keyed by session and event, atomic receipt/outbox, retryable failures, no double inventory changes; independent paid status.
entries.marketing_claim: Local file proof gate passed, distributed one-time delivery NOT VERIFIED.

entries.blocking_test: Task names, full action arguments and binary/script SHA-256 inventory against signed approved baseline; alert on changed task or unsigned activation; turn on script block logging where permitted.
entries.marketing_claim: Task integrity not verified on user's PC.

entries.blocking_test: External model suggestions quarantined; signed/evidence corroboration before promotion; memory versioning and rollback; test cross-session poisoning.
entries.marketing_claim: No claim poisoned memory is impossible, even if ledger hash chain is intact.

entries.blocking_test: Cross-page truth contract: exact price, paid deliverables, intake, fulfilment timing, refunds, subscription terms; human legal review.
entries.marketing_claim: No unsupported statements of NZ$5m current automatic liability.
